en: A black-and-white vintage view over a calm body of water toward a tree-lined shore with several large villa-style houses partly hidden among the trees. Overhanging branches frame the top of the image. At the bottom of the picture are printed captions: on the left, the bilingual place name "Helsingfors - Helsinki" and on the right the more specific location "Turholm." The overall design and typography resemble an early 20th-century photographic postcard.
